captured_note: The inventory (docs/INVENTORY.md) classifies Franca as submodule+patch, Apache. The 9984B patch is for the capture's Step 2 (from-scratch SSL pretraining), which is excluded like every method's step 2. The portable part is the capture's Step 1: a frozen pretrained-backbone linear probe (methods/36_franca/README.md: 'analogous to DINOv2 ... not local Franca pretraining'). The frozen forward has no hardcoded device, so this port pins the upstream DIRECTLY with no fork.
note: The Step-1 backbone is the pinned upstream under third_party/franca, imported and never copied (DESIGN section 1). Two comparisons are ported: Step 1 (as-is) is a frozen-backbone linear probe of the official downloaded Franca ViT-B/14; Step 2 (unified) trains a ViT-B/16 from scratch on ImageNet-1k with Franca's objective and linear-probes the trained encoder (recipe: unified on the eval). The from-scratch Step 2 is ported additively so Franca sits on the same unified axis as every other method (ImageNet-1k for all removes the data confound).
linear_eval: Probes Franca's pretrained ViT-B/14 CLS token (forward_features(x)['x_norm_clstoken']), frozen. Unlike var's tokeniser probe, this is a genuine SSL representation, so the number is comparable (the capture's 'Step 1 caveat / pretrained-backbone reuse' row, analogous to DINOv2). A real run needs the official checkpoint (backbone_artifact below, fetched and hash-verified by bin/fetch-weights.py, passed as the config's train.ckpt); the hermetic smoke leaves ckpt empty and builds a random backbone (pretrained=False), so nothing is downloaded and only the pipeline is exercised. See docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md.

backbone_artifact.name: Franca ViT-B/14 In21K backbone
backbone_artifact.sha256_source: measured on 2026-08-05 by a full download from the GitHub release; bin/fetch-weights.py re-verifies this value on download

rewritten_during_the_port: the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of assumed CUDA
features are extracted in fp32; the capture used a bfloat16 autocast, a GPU speed path with no meaningful effect on a frozen-feature linear probe and not portable to a CPU or a pre-Ampere GPU
RASA is disabled (use_rasa_head=False); the capture README notes the official RASA loader mismatches ViT-B/14, and the CLS probe does not use it
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the four comparable linear-probe accuracies and the epoch count

Step 1 (as-is) freezes the official downloaded Franca backbone; Step 2 (unified) is ported additively: a from-scratch ViT-B/16 pretraining + a linear_eval that probes the trained encoder (recipe: unified). The eval-only Step-1 path is unchanged.

the unified Step-2 model is ported from the capture's methods/36_franca/train_step2_vit.py (defined inline there): it reuses the DINOv2 ViT backbone (DINOv2Backbone on a timm ViT) and KoLeo loss -- vendored into models/ since this repo's methods are isolated -- and adds Franca's own contribution: the nested Matryoshka DINO/iBOT heads (MatryoshkaHead over nesting_dims) and the Sinkhorn-Knopp teacher normalisation (FrancaDinoLoss/FrancaIBOTLoss) instead of DINOv2's centering. The ViT dims are threaded into timm so a hermetic CPU smoke runs a tiny ViT; timm is added to the lock at the fleet version (timm==1.0.28), built from scratch so CI stays hermetic.

the capture's franca_data imported 28_dinov2's build_dinov2_augmentation across method directories; the port vendors that augmentation into data/franca_dataset.py so the method is self-contained and its data package does not collide with another method's. The cyclic inverse-block masking (CyclicMaskGenerator) and stratified mask sampling are kept.

train_pretrain_vit_franca.py is a single-process port of train_step2_vit.py: the per-step warmup->cosine LR, per-step teacher-momentum and teacher-temp schedules, the Sinkhorn losses + KoLeo and gradient-norm clipping are kept; DDP, bf16 autocast, TensorBoard and the distributed health gate are dropped. The adapter gained a pretrain stage (nested config) + a recipe: unified Step-2 linear_eval that probes the trained teacher encoder.pt (ENCODER_PREFIX teacher_bb.) at its CLS token; configs/pretrain_vit.yaml and configs/linear_eval_vit.yaml are added.
